item.text:
**Findings**
- Medium: crash and plugin error notifications still duplicated the same `ReportActivity` setup sequence: create the report intents, allocate a unique notification ID, wrap `contentIntent`/`deleteIntent`, then pass them into the notification builder. That logic lived in two separate flows and was easy to let drift.

I refactored that into [TermuxNotificationUtils.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/notification/TermuxNotificationUtils.java:23) with a shared `ReportActivityNotificationIntents` value object and `getReportActivityNotificationIntents(...)` helper at [line 67](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/notification/TermuxNotificationUtils.java:67). Both callers now delegate to it: [TermuxCrashUtils.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/crash/TermuxCrashUtils.java:325) and [TermuxPluginUtils.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/plugins/TermuxPluginUtils.java:367).

Static verification shows `ReportActivity.newInstance(...)` now has a single use site in the shared notification helper. I could not run a build or tests because `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar` is missing and `gradle` is not installed in this workspace.
